## Standing operator rules
Every added Python dependency must include a security-exception.md entry countersigned by @omar before CI may pass.

Run `prod-db-credential-rotation` between other work, completing these steps in order: check Vault; record old lease; mint replacement; update Kubernetes secret; restart `orders-api`; verify startup; revoke old lease; remove temporary files.

Never edit api/openapi.yaml without first posting the proposed diff in #ledgerly-api and tagging @dana-api.

Important: the active schema is billing_v3 now. billing_v1 is a frozen snapshot used by finance; never seed or write into it.

Stop the tenacity refactor, we will revisit it next sprint.

Paste the exact test output next time instead of paraphrasing.

## Current objective
Fix double-counting of refunds in nightly `ledgerly/jobs/reconcile.py`. Credential rotation is paused after replacement minting.

## Ruled-out approaches
- Do not modify the unrelated legacy invoice rounding fixture.
- Adding invoices(customer_id, created_at) index doubled ingest write latency.
- Do not retry 4xx client errors; only transport and retryable server errors qualify.
- Stop pursuing the tenacity refactor until next sprint.

## Recent work
CSV UTF-8 patch passed `186 passed, 3 skipped`; Ruff and diff checks passed. Began invoice type annotations; baseline invoice tests passed. Latest completed edit annotated `calculate_totals` without changing output keys.
